title: Pure Arcana Force
summary: Arcana Force cards with generic coin-toss support and staples. Every Arcana Force monster tosses a coin when summoned, and Light Barrier lets you pick the result instead, so the Field Spell is the deck. Arcana Force XV - The Fiend discards itself to search it. The 2025 wave leads. Arcana Force V - The Hierophant summons a different small Arcana from the Deck on heads, and discarded, stops responses to your Arcana summons. Arcana Force XIX - The Sun summons itself while a coin card is out and sets a coin Spell from the Deck. Light Force, a generic Continuous Spell built for the deck, searches two Arcana Force monsters. Arcana Force EX - The Chaos Ruler is a Contact Fusion of three different Arcanas that summons a Level 10 Ruler from the Deck and, with Light Barrier up, stops monster effects on the field. Arcana Force XII - The Hangman is not out in the TCG yet. The list runs one of each small Arcana so The Hierophant and The Chaos Ruler have different names to work with.
